features.title: Build through conversation
features.description: Keep your campaign chat beside every tab. Answer questions one at a time and review your draft campaign brief.

features.title: Preview before applying
features.description: Review proposed missions, characters, scene links and terrain layouts before the client applies them.

features.title: Simpler AI setup
features.description: Choose OpenAI or Claude, enter your key and explicitly test it. Advanced model settings remain optional. Provider requests may incur charges.

features.title: Private usage tracking
features.description: View reported tokens and estimated USD costs across restarts. Your campaign files stay local, and manual editing still works offline.
